scripts.dev: npm run build:sdks && npm run setup && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @app/api" "npm run dev -w @app/web"
scripts.build:sdks: npm run build -w @pkg/sdk-js && npm run build -w @pkg/sdk-node
scripts.build: npm run build:sdks && npm run build -w @app/api && npm run build -w @app/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sdk-js && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sdk-node && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
